messages.subject: "Fixed" effects not showing
parts:
I have a model that looks something like this:

m <- inla(y ~ x + f(group, model = "iid) etc...

And generally, this model gives me the outputs I expect e.g. estimates of the intercept, slope, random effects etc.

But very rarely, my model doesnt provide estimates of the fixed feects (intercept and x) either in summary(m) or m$summary.fixed

This is so rare that I cant provide a reproducible example. Am I missing something really obvious here?
